title: Restructure operation manifest
description: manifest.json. The exact set of file operations a restructure run proposes. Approval binds to this artifact's digest, so 'approved for this exact operation set' becomes a checkable fact rather than a promise in prose.

scope.description: Absolute path of the tree these operations apply to. Recorded so a manifest cannot be executed against a different tree than the one it was proposed for.

rationale.description: Why this structure, in terms of the evidence gathered. layout.md owns what counts as evidence.

operations.description: Every path-level decision, including keeps. A keep is recorded rather than implied, so a reader can tell a considered decision from an overlooked file.

destination.description: Required for move and rename, forbidden otherwise. Enforced imperatively, because the dependency is between sibling fields.

references.description: Surfaces that name this path and must be repaired with it: imports, manifests, tests, pipelines, documentation, deployment.
